title: Cloud hosting cost grows faster than forecast
description: Usage growth in the core platform raises monthly hosting cost above budget, leading to a full-year overspend.
mitigation: Complete the cost optimisation review; set budget alerts; evaluate reserved capacity; report monthly variance.

title: Ransomware entering through a phishing email
description: A user opens a malicious email, malware spreads and operations stop, causing loss of service and data and a possible regulatory notification.
mitigation: Extend multi-factor authentication to 100 percent of accounts; email filtering; immutable backups; quarterly phishing exercises; tested incident plan.

title: Core operations platform outage in a peak period
description: A failure or failed change takes the platform offline during a busy period, delaying shipments and customer service.
mitigation: Change freeze in peak weeks; tested rollback plans; supplier escalation route; annual disaster recovery test.

title: Key-person dependency for integration knowledge
description: Two people hold most knowledge of system integrations. Absence or departure would slow fixes and projects.
mitigation: Document integrations; pair a second engineer on each; add a retained support partner option.

title: Supplier delays warehouse scanner delivery again
description: A second hardware delay would push the rollout beyond December and into the peak period.
mitigation: Weekly supplier call; agreed delivery date in writing; fallback of phased site go-live.

title: Unsupported operating systems on legacy devices
description: Devices that no longer receive vendor security updates remain in use and become an entry point for attack.
mitigation: Asset review; replace through the device refresh budget; isolate any exception on a restricted network.

title: Service desk contract ends before replacement is live
description: Re-tender and transition take longer than planned, leaving a gap in service or forcing a poor-value extension.
mitigation: Agree a short extension option in writing; start transition planning before contract award.

title: Personal data shared through misconfigured access
description: A sharing setting exposes files containing personal data to people who should not see them.
mitigation: Quarterly access review; default-private sharing policy; data loss prevention alerts.

title: Backup restore not tested within the last 12 months
description: Backups exist but a full restore has not been proven, so recovery time after a major failure is uncertain.
mitigation: Schedule a restore test in the next disaster recovery exercise; record the measured recovery time.

title: Single-source scanning software supplier fails
description: The supplier of the scanning application becomes insolvent or withdraws the product.
mitigation: Escrow or code access arrangement; annual supplier financial check; documented exit plan.
